principle_violations.reason: The PaymentProcessor interface forces all derived classes to implement the 'auth_sms' method, even though this method is not applicable to all payment processors (e.g., PayPal or credit card processors).
principle_violations.suggestion: Refactor the base PaymentProcessor class and introduce a separate interface or abstract class for processors supporting SMS authentication. This allows implementations to adhere only to the contracts they need.
